PluginData.Author: TH3ShadowDragon
PluginData.Tooltip: Bullets and the use key go where the crosshair points while Over The Shoulder+ or the cover mod drives the camera.
PluginData.Description:
Companion plugin for Over The Shoulder+ and "Take cover or die".
While either camera mod is active this plugin makes shots and the use/interact key follow the on-screen crosshair instead of a fixed point in front of the character's head.
Also provides: - Aim zoom support from Over The Shoulder+ - Sprint while the cover mod runs you to a wall - A/D walk along cover (W/S and Space blocked in cover) - Jump blocked while in cover - Hides the game's crosshair when the cover mod shows its red one
Does nothing when those camera mods are off. Single player only.
Source and issues: https://github.com/aegonthe5th-crTheeatTe/CrosshairAim
